interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk or install curb extensions to provide adequate walking space around existing mature trees and street furniture.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearing and Enforcement
interventions.description: Implement measures to ensure the sidewalk remains clear of parked vehicles and debris to maintain an accessible path.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or a furniture zone to provide a physical buffer between pedestrians and the roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Regular clearing of debris and construction materials to maintain a clear and safe walking path.
